identity.name: Submariner
identity.one_liner: The no-date Submariner in the current 41mm case, caliber 3230, from 2020.

narrative.story: The 124060 continues the no-date line that traces to the original 1953 Submariner: the cleanest dial in the range, no cyclops, and a lower list price than the Date. The 2020 update gave it the time-only 3230 and the revised case with slimmer lugs. Purists tend to prefer it, while the market prices it below the Date versions.
narrative.collector_notes: The most attainable modern Sub at retail and on the grey market. The symmetric dial and uninterrupted crystal are why buyers pick it over the 126610LN — not price alone.
